in_marathi.name: Vikash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikash is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vijñāna', meaning knowledge or wisdom. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known as the giver of knowledge and the preserver of the universe. A name like Vikash bestows the blessings of knowledge and wisdom upon the child.
